content.comment_body: • [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]) • [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] Is it possible to download the latest data log from a [product_name] without needing to install [product_name]? Why isn't there an option to download the data log from the device’s web server? The Excel macro also doesn't work with newer Office versions. I have seen similar questions before but haven't found any clear solution.

The data log is a CSV file stored on the SD card. The card inserted in the device can't be accessed directly. You either use [product_name] or remove the card and read it on a PC. Afterward, you can import the log file into Excel.

analysis.insight_summary: Users express frustration over not being able to directly access or download the data log file from the web server of the device. Access requires using dedicated software or physically removing the SD card. Additionally, the Excel macro provided does not work with recent versions of Office, making data extraction and analysis more challenging.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy way to download the latest data log directly from the device’s web server and smoothly work with it in modern Excel without needing extra software or manual steps.
